summary: Frontend-only validation completed on public preview for homepage consolidation, compact layout, responsive behavior, proof tabs/connectors/ROI, route accessibility, SEO/AEO metadata, and regression checks. Most acceptance criteria pass. One key visual spec mismatch remains: desktop MacBook appears smaller than required 78-82% proportion (~75.5% measured). Product scenarios remain explicitly labeled as MOCKED content; no API flow was mocked.

ui_bugs.issue: Desktop MacBook visual width in compact product section is below requested 78-82% target. Measured ~75.5% of product-column width at 1920x800.

action_items: Adjust compact desktop MacBook sizing so effective rendered proportion is within 78-82% of product column (current measured ~75.5%).
Re-verify narration play/pause/stop progression in a browser environment with full SpeechSynthesis event support (headless automation kept status at idle, so progression was not fully assertable).
critical_code_review_comments: Homepage structure/order and deduplication requirements are satisfied in runtime DOM: five approved sections only, compact total height (~4657px at 1920x800), and removed duplicate sections absent.
BinaryHandsCanvas lifecycle regression appears fixed: onscreen animation changes, offscreen pause stable hashes, onscreen resume changes, and reduced-motion freeze behavior all passed.
Maintainability risk: very large stylesheet modules (notably cinematic/global styles) remain high-complexity and can increase regression probability for future motion/layout edits.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified on https://agent-os-21.internal.preview.emergentagent.com. Passed: five-part homepage order, duplicate-section removal checks, compact scroll height, eye-before-AHI placement, 9 industries + 9 surfaces, hash-driven connector tab activation, connectors search/filter/empty state, ROI recalculation, direct routes (/pricing /partners /roi /use-cases/healthcare /use-cases/cfo /resources), JSON-LD/canonical/meta/llms/sitemap/robots, waitlist modal opens from hero/founder, no runtime duplicate data-testid values, no horizontal overflow across 320x700/390x844/768x900/1024x900/1440x900/1920x800, and binary canvas offscreen pause/resume + reduced-motion freeze. Remaining issue: MacBook desktop proportion under target (~75.5% vs required 78-82%).
rca of the issue: Reproduction: open homepage at 1920x800, scroll to compact AHI section, compare .ahi-macbook-wrap width to [data-testid='ahi-sticky-product'] width via getBoundingClientRect. Expected 0.78-0.82, observed ~0.755. Root cause is effective rendered sizing after container padding/layout constraints causing net width below intended visual target. Mitigation: slightly increase compact .ahi-macbook-wrap width basis or adjust surrounding product-column internal spacing until measured runtime ratio falls inside 0.78-0.82 without clipping.
